description: List the Models with no Session running: the host starts the adapter only to list (New session opened with no Codex Session), so list_models is its first and only command. The adapter initialises Codex and asks model/list straight away, never starting a thread (which would leave a stray thread in Codex's history), and answers with every page's Models. Synthesised from the codex app-server JSON schema generated by codex-cli 0.144.1 (`codex app-server generate-json-schema`), not captured from a live run: replace with a capture (see crates/codex-adapter/README.md).
